card.name: Words just before a numeric threshold
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a number limit in dosing tables, such as "to" in a range, "Grade" or "weight" before a sign like ≤, <, or ≥. It fires where the next token is a comparison or range value.

modes.label: Range "to"
modes.description: The word "to" linking two numbers in a range of lab values or kidney function.

modes.label: Label before comparison
modes.description: A noun such as weight or Grade that is followed by ≤, <, or ≥ and a value.

modes.label: Inside a name before a limit
modes.description: The end of a drug or class name in a table row, just before a comparison sign.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "greater than" or "less than" (mostly Chinese) and comparison signs, so it pushes the model to write a comparison next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where a cutoff such as greater than, less than, or up to a number is about to come.
